reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a file folder with a right-pointing arrow inside, universally understood in computing as moving, transferring, or navigating to a folder. It fits digital file management, backup migration, and document organization tasks well, though it can occasionally be confused with generic file export or email-to-folder actions.
